run_prerelax_with_chgnet: run CHGNet structure relaxation on a pymatgen Structure and return the unrelaxed-relaxed pair with energies
run_structures_to_chgnet_graphs: run parallel conversion of a list of pymatgen Structures into CHGNet CrystalGraph objects using joblib
create_UnrelaxedRelaxedStructurePair_fro: create an UnrelaxedRelaxedStructurePair from a CHGNet prediction dict and relaxation result containing final structure and trajectory
review_UnrelaxedRelaxedStructurePair_rms: review the RMS distance between unrelaxed and relaxed structures using a StructureMatcher with configurable tolerances
review_RelaxationData: review the RelaxationData dataclass that collects indices, energies, RMS distances, and convergence status for batch relaxations
